description: This file defines the class GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate, a specialized display field class used within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It extends the GenericDateDisplayField class and adds functionality to handle aggregate functions (like MAX) for date fields such as employment contract start and end dates, providing methods for setting display parameters and generating parts of SQL select statements.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregate
classes.description: A class that extends display field capabilities to include aggregate functions such as MAX on date fields within reporting.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the display field with its associated entity alias, field, and aggregate based on the provided DisplayField object.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class name used for data transfer.

methods.name: getAggregate
methods.description: Retrieves the current aggregate function used for the display field.

methods.name: setAggregate
methods.description: Sets the aggregate function (e.g., MAX) to be used.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Generates the SQL select statement portion for this display field, including the aggregate function and fields.
